description: Trigger a run when a Salesforce object has new or updated records.
summary: Trigger a run when Salesforce records are created or updated.

outputs.description: RunRequest per new or updated Salesforce record

asset_keys.description: Slash-separated asset keys to materialize when a record matches.
asset_keys.label: Asset Keys

fields.description: SOQL fields to select. 'Id' and 'LastModifiedDate' are used internally -- include them even if you add more.
fields.label: Fields

soql_filter.description: Additional WHERE clause, ANDed with the LastModifiedDate cursor filter (e.g. "StageName = 'Closed Won'").
soql_filter.label: Soql Filter

resource_key.description: Optional resource key registered by a SalesforceResourceComponent. When set, queries run via that resource's own soql(...) method at run time instead of the inline consumer_key/consumer_secret/username/password/security_token below -- lets one Salesforce credential serve the ingestion connector, the salesforce_record_upsert reverse-ETL sink, and this sensor without configuring it three times. Only meaningful when that resource is configured with auth_mode='password' (this sensor's standalone path only supports the password grant, not JWT Bearer, either).
resource_key.label: Resource Key

domain.description: 'login' (production) or 'test' (sandbox). Ignored when resource_key is set.
domain.label: Domain

consumer_key.description: Connected App consumer key. Required unless resource_key is set.
consumer_key.label: Consumer Key

consumer_secret.description: Connected App consumer secret. Required unless resource_key is set.
consumer_secret.label: Consumer Secret

username.description: Salesforce username. Required unless resource_key is set.
username.label: Username

password.description: Salesforce password. Required unless resource_key is set.
password.label: Password

security_token.description: Salesforce security token (Settings > Personal Setup > Reset My Security Token). Required unless resource_key is set.
security_token.label: Security Token

api_version.description: Salesforce REST API version. Ignored when resource_key is set.
api_version.label: Api Version

name: SalesforceRecordSensor
